summary: Prepare canonical keyed work summaries with captured-time deadlines

replay.detail: Default runtime and readers are unchanged. The prepared operator has no read/open history fold or implicit populated installation.

schema.detail: Explicit View registration creates local summary/clock tables and a deadline index, alongside the foundation contribution tables. No default production schema version changes.

rules.detail: Canonical admission, original-repair eligibility, effective work state and checkpoint rules are unchanged. Partial summary state does not certify work authority or checkpoint coverage.

compatibility.detail: No public routes, cursor, socket or action changes. The prepared relation preserves existing progress and completion summary interpretation.

downtime.detail: No production registration or reader activation. No new startup replay or restart requirement.

manual.detail: Consumer adoption must explicitly register, capture all source mutations, certify complete projection, install populated candidates and drain bounded captured-time pages. Full work dependency and authority coverage needs separate proof.

recovery.detail: Source mutations remain fenced. Populated installation and checkpoint/digest/restore participation of custom summary rows are not certified.
